description: Online partition-native path cases. Result truth remains owned by the Phase 40.13.16 scalar oracle while this matrix requires complete distributed traversal evidence.

cases.query: SELECT DISTINCT ?s ?o WHERE { ?s (<http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#subClassOf>|<http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#equivalentClass>)+ ?o } ORDER BY ?s ?o LIMIT 100
